shape.description: Analytic 2D SDF shape: circle or rounded box. Upstream default sphere3D/volumetric/shape JSON platform NOT_SUPPORTED.

scale.description: Uniform shape scale in the rotated field space.

rotation.description: Rigid in-plane rotation of the field; 360 is identity.

hueShift.description: Rotates the rainbow spectrum across the foil; 360 is the identity period.

foilScale.description: Iridescent patch size — higher means smaller, busier patches.

saturation.description: Rainbow saturation; 0 is plain silver foil, 1 fully spectral.

roughness.description: Matte laminate grain; also softens the gloss highlight.

speed.description: Animated-time speed; 0 pauses the spectrum drift.

crinkle.description: Laminate wrinkle strength; 0 leaves the flat dome normal.

crinkleScale.description: Wrinkle feature size — higher means smaller, denser wrinkles.

sparkle.description: Glitter flake density; 0 removes the flake layer.

edgeSoftness.description: Shape boundary softness; at 0 the edge stays anti-aliased.

seed.description: Local extension: offsets every noise input coordinate. 0 is the upstream fixed-domain noise.
